name: The Ritz-Carlton, Hong Kong
positioning: High-rise hotel on floors 102 to 118 of the International Commerce Centre in Kowloon, atop the Elements shopping mall
best_for: Travelers who want harbour and city views from a high floor
Families interested in the Ritz Kids Night Safari

facts.text: The hotel occupies floors 102 to 118 of the International Commerce Centre in Kowloon.
The hotel sits atop the Elements shopping mall.
All rooms and suites have unobstructed views of the harbour and city through expansive windows.
Tin Lung Heen serves refined Cantonese cuisine, traditional dim sum and premium tea.
Tosca di Angelo serves Italian dining in a room with high ceilings, fountains and chandeliers.
Cafe 103 is named for its setting on the hotel's 103rd floor and is known for lunch and dinner buffets.
The spa is on the 116th floor and overlooks Victoria Harbour.
On the 118th floor the hotel has an indoor infinity pool and a gym, both overlooking the harbour.
The Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations five times each day.

highlights.text: The Ritz-Carlton Suite is on the 117th floor and is described as the highest hotel suite in the city.
Ozone is described as the highest hotel bar in the world, at 1,607 feet above sea level.
Ritz Kids Night Safari lets children set up camp in the family's room.
The hotel is on top of the Airport Express Kowloon station, where guests can check bags before a flight.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service.
Condé Nast Traveler notes the area's general lack of walkability.
Club access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to the Club.
